audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored Skill though its why calls it 'your single biggest window'; first item was scored Kennen though its why calls it 'a coin-flip on timing'; 2+ items was scored Kennen though its why says he out-sustains you and you should play for teamfights.
audit.why: 50.53% over 475 games with the swing inside it: Kennen owns 2-3 and 6, first item is genuinely even, and Teemo takes the late once mushrooms cover the map.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 -> Kennen, 5 -> Skill, 6 -> Teemo in matched pairs. That is the packet chart.

audit.why: Levels 4-5 belong to nobody: Teemo has Q at rank 3 at best and no mushrooms until 6, so his control there is range and Move Quick, exactly as the mirror recorded.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart's flat 7s at every rank added, so the reader stops waiting for a cooldown that never lengthens.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page over-rates the blind: 'your mark-stacking stalls', 'a blinded R-combo loses your Electrical Surge autos and half the burst'. It also calls Move Quick his passive in two fields.
audit.why: Kennen has four mark sources — Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge's active, Lightning Rush and Slicing Maelstrom — plus the passive auto-mark. Blind denies exactly one of them, the auto-attack. It delays three stacks; it never prevents them, and it cannot touch the storm at all. And Teemo's passive is Guerrilla Warfare (invisibility while standing still, or while moving in brush); Move Quick is W.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as costing one of four sources; Move Quick and Guerrilla Warfare named to their correct slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated the range gap or how Teemo answers Slicing Maelstrom.
audit.why: Kennen's Q is 950 against Blinding Dart's 680 — a 270-unit gap that is the entire early game. And the answer to the storm is distance: it is 550 radius and Move Quick simply walks him out, which is why the ult has to follow a stun rather than open the fight.
audit.corrected: Both stated in early, whys[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: ownerKit Q range 950 and R range 550

audit.whatIsWrong: Guerrilla Warfare was never named, and the reason brush is lethal was left implicit.
audit.why: He becomes invisible standing still, and can move while invisible inside brush — with no reveal in Kennen's kit, that is why a sweeper before an all-in matters as much as sweeping mushrooms.

edits.before: Teemo's blind (Q) is the problem child here — it shuts off your autos and your Electrical Surge on-hit, so your mark-stacking stalls if you walk into it carelessly. The flip side: you out-range him with Thundering Shuriken (Q), so poke at max distance and stack Mark of the Storm from afar where his blind does nothing to a skillshot. At levels 2-3 you get your cleanest window — a second Q plus W on already-marked targets can land a two-spell stun if he oversteps to CS, so punish greedy last-hits.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is the problem child — it shuts off your autos and the Electrical Surge on-hit mark, one of your four mark sources, so a blind delays three stacks rather than preventing them. The flip side: 950 range against his 680 means you poke from outside his answer and stack Mark of the Storm where a blind does nothing to a skillshot. At levels 2-3 you get your cleanest window — a second Q plus W on an already-marked target lands a two-spell stun if he oversteps to CS.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a respect stretch — he kites with his move-speed passive and E poison chips you while you wait, so don't force without your stun ready. Level 6 is your window: hold a Q mark, then E-in and channel Slicing Maelstrom — the AoE storm restacks marks fast and the third-stack stun locks him with no dash to escape. The catch is timing it for when his blind is on cooldown, because a blinded R-combo loses your Electrical Surge autos and half the burst.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a respect stretch — he kites with Move Quick (W) and Toxic Shot chips you while you wait, so don't force without your stun ready. Level 6 is your window: hold a Q mark, then E-in and cast Slicing Maelstrom — the AoE storm restacks marks fast and the third-stack stun locks him with no dash to escape. Blind cannot stop that: it denies your autos only, so Q, W-active and the storm all keep applying Mark of the Storm.

edits.before: This is where he reclaims the lane. Once he hits two items his shrooms wall off every E engage path and his blind plus kite let him whittle your squishy caster body whenever your R is down. You can't sit in a straight 1v1 here — pivot to roaming and teamfighting where your R stun-locks a clump instead of chasing one kiting Teemo. Sweep mushroom walls before any all-in and never facecheck brush near objectives.

notes: The blind was over-rated across the page. Kennen has four mark sources plus the passive auto-mark; Blinding Dart denies exactly one of them, so it delays a three-stack stun and never prevents it, and it cannot touch Slicing Maelstrom at all. Move Quick was called his passive twice — his passive is Guerrilla Warfare (invisibility standing still, or moving inside brush), which is the real reason to sweep before an all-in and which the page never named. Also wrote in the 950-vs-680 range gap and the flat 7s Q cooldown at every rank.
